new: A real app: every screen is inside the app, like a bank app. It no longer opens the website in a window.
Sign in once, then open ReqGen with your app PIN or fingerprint.
Direct requests to one or many people, from any department. Each person answers on their own.
Every request you send and every decision needs the 6-digit code sent by SMS and e-mail.
fixed: Approving no longer asks for an authenticator app. The SMS or e-mail code is enough.
better: Saved lists show at once, even on a weak network or offline.
What each officer said shows on the request, and prints with it.
